text:
alex_pm: Quick async readout — pricing change implementation dependencies. Goal: cut staging by Tue (2026-03-24). Need green on metering, billing mapping, quota overrides, contract/proration. Summarized items below. :eyes:

mike_metering: PR #452 is in review (metering-adapter). Tests passing locally; still need SDK bump (client v2.1) to support `sample_rate` field. ETA: Fri EOD. If SDK can't ship, we can shim on server side but cost visibility degrades.

jamal_billing: Billing mapping work started — plan_id -> billing_code mapping table needs to include new `pro_v2` and `enterprise_plus`. Without mapping invoices will show 'unknown_plan' and hurt contract reporting. Migration job scheduled Wed night. Need contract team to confirm plan codes.

li_legal: Looked at S.3 and proration language. We can keep existing proration but need product sign-off on rounding rules. Also need to ensure contracts mention 'temporary promotional credits' — does pricing change affect legacy grandfathering? Please share list of affected customer IDs.

sara_eng: Integration test found quota edge: legacy orgs with per-user hard caps return 422 on update. I pushed a temporary config toggle `allow_auto_quota_override: true` to staging. Not ideal. Prefer contract + billing confirm intended behavior so we can make change permanent.

mike_metering: Note: enabling auto override will change metered billing for affected orgs — will add noise to month. Recommend we gate with rollout flag and alerting.

jamal_billing: Agreed. We'll add an invoice note for migrated customers. Can ops add audit logs for changed quotas?

sara_eng: ops already has `quota-change` audit events in staging. I'll add retention for 90 days.

li_legal: I'll draft contract addendum language for proration + quota overrides, aim to have a PR by Mon.

alex_pm: Action items: mike - SDK/PR ETA Fri; jamal - plan mapping + migration Wed; li - contract PR Mon; sara - keep staging toggle and final test by Mon; ops - enable invoice note & audit retention. If everyone green by Mon EOD we target staging cut Tue morning. Ping here with short updates. :thumbsup:

deploy_bot: canary deploy scheduled: staging-pricing-change -> 1912345688 (Wed 02:15 UTC).

sara_eng: quick FYI — test failures related to quotas fixed, rerunning full suite.

jamal_billing: added `pro_v2` mapping to staging DB, migration dry-run ok.

mike_metering: PR merged to main, SDK bump queued.

li_legal: contract PR opened: #98 — link: https://git.company/contract-addendum/98

alex_pm: Thanks all. I'll compile a short sync doc for execs tomorrow.
